Description: Unique identifier assigned to each employee. Used as the primary key to uniquely identify employee records in the table.
Full name of the employee. Used for reporting and employee identification.
Business department or functional area to which the employee belongs such as IT Finance HR Sales or Marketing.
Official designation or role assigned to the employee within the organization.
Date on which the employee joined the organization. Used for tenure analysis and workforce reporting.

column10: Current annual salary of the employee stored with two decimal precision. Used for compensation and payroll analysis.
